entry.title: Osun Grove road entrance gate
entry.note: The vehicle opening follows the existing PMTiles approach. The town-facing angle follows the photographed facade. The mapped road location is 3.55 m northwest of the overhead trace, and the placement is an approximate visualization.

terrainReference.basis: Terrarium sample at the mapped crossing on the road centerline.

roadFit.notes: The existing pavement passes through the open iron leaves. Eight sampled heights between 0.27 and 2.9 m clear the reported width in all four detail levels. The piers reach the native field outside the sampled road surface. The estimate follows PMTiles where it differs from the overhead trace.

trialSegment.basis: A straight approach connects the existing junction to the aerial gate centre. A cubic joins the gate to the next existing point inside the grove, with matched tangents at the gate and the far endpoint. Trees obscure most of the rear segment.

earlierAerialRoadTrial.limitation: The November 15 and 18 PMTiles extracts have identical geometry for the approach. At the aerial gate coordinate, a trial centerline clears a 5.4 m band and preserves the existing junction and adjacent roads. The segment beyond the gate is interpolated under canopy. Its exact course and the gate anchor remain pending; this trial does not establish a production map correction.

controls.basis: The straight town-side approach joins the mapped junction to the photographed opening. A cubic reconnects the crossing to the original line 16 m inside the grove. It matches the original exit tangent. Trees obscure the inner alignment, so the rejoin remains an estimate.

boundedAerialRoadTrial.limitation: This is a local fixture with one edited road. The shipped viewer still uses the mapped road and the road-centered preview. The short correction needs a source-matched runtime path before the gate can be moved to the aerial anchor.

runtimeRoadAlignment.review: Read the built Earth pack and decoded the hash-checked PMTiles source. The detailed feature layer uses the corrected road after overzoom. The terrain-relative gate uses the photographed anchor and the same signed heading.
runtimeRoadAlignment.limitation: The short road section under tree cover remains interpolated. The road-centered preview stays active if the source lacks the expected segment or has finer native feature tiles.

entry.title: Osun Grove road entrance gate
entry.note: The vehicle opening follows the existing PMTiles approach. The town-facing angle follows the photographed facade. The mapped road location is 3.55 m northwest of the overhead trace, and the placement is an approximate visualization.

terrainReference.basis: Terrarium sample at the mapped crossing on the road centerline.

review: The town-facing facade matches the entrance photos and the overhead pier line. The shipped source correction uses the aerial anchor and clears 5.3 m across the gate. The road-centered fallback is 3.55 m northwest and clears 5.1 m on the retained baseline road. Both were rendered at all four levels using the owning tile’s terrain, with no host sampler. Terrain under the piers and other mapped features were retained. The short road curve under the canopy is estimated.
